summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: an Item 2.02/8-K disclosure) reporting a share buyback by the Company and its wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U., acting under Article 64 of Argentine Capital Markets Law No. 26,831. CPSA acquired 100,000 ordinary shares on BYMA at an average AR$1,952.39 per share (AR$195.2M total) and Proener acquired 20,000 ADRs on the NYSE at US$12.12 per ADR (US$242,516 total), both settling October 1, 2026. The purchases stayed below 25% of the prior 90-day average daily volume, limiting market-impact and overhang concerns.
